seo.title: About Bar 7 | Upton upon Severn Sports Pub
seo.description: Discover Bar 7, a welcoming sports bar and pub in Upton upon Severn with drinks, live sport, music, pool and darts near Great Malvern.

hero.title: A pub that feels easy from the first pint
hero.lead: We’re a no-fuss sports bar and pub in Upton upon Severn with a neighbourhood feel, built for good company, drinks and live sport.

story: Bar 7 Sports Bar is designed for people who want a proper pub night without the fuss. Find us in Upton upon Severn in the Malvern Hills district, a short trip from Great Malvern. The room is relaxed, the drinks are cold, and the screens keep everyone in the game.
Whether you’re dropping in for a quick pint, watching the football, or settling in with friends for the evening, the aim is the same: keep the service sharp and the atmosphere welcoming.

values.title: Welcoming
values.text: A place where regulars, visitors, and first-timers all get the same easy-going service.

values.title: Reliable
values.text: Simple, well-kept drinks, familiar favourites, and a team that keeps the room moving.

values.title: Lively
values.text: Big matches, weekend energy, and enough volume to make important moments land.

whatToExpect: Screens positioned for sport without overwhelming the room.
Comfortable seating for groups and casual drop-ins.
A small selection of bar snacks is available; ask the team for the current choice.
Straightforward access from Old Street in Upton upon Severn.

outdoor.title: Outdoor seating for the whole group
outdoor.text: Enjoy our outdoor seating area, with a small children’s play area featuring a slide and swing set. We also have a sheltered smoking area with heat lamps for cooler evenings.
